_contract: DATA_CONTRACT.md §10 — the site's ONE hand-curated data file. Every entry transcribed from the cited official document; rates are Rand-per-Rand as gazetted; residential_reduction is the TOTAL value excluded for an ordinary residential property (statutory R15,000 MPRA s17(1)(h) included). A municipality absent here (Breede Valley: municipal site bot-blocked) shows NO rates figure on the site. Optional residential extras: residential_rebate_pct (% off the calculated amount) and residential_exempt_below (full exemption at/below this valuation). Overstrand ships res only — its non-residential 2025/26 randages are not published in a quotable document.

prime_rate.quote: SARB prime lending rate = repo policy rate 7.00% + 3.50% margin = 10.50%, effective 28 May 2026 (repo raised 25 bps at the May 2026 MPC meeting, the first hike since 2023; prime = repo + 3.5% is the standard SA relationship). Used only for the labelled affordability estimate.
